## <small>4.3.2 (2026-06-12)</small>

* chore(deps): bump semantic-release to 25 for npm trusted publishing (#1029) ([6eb168c](https://github.com/commitizen/cz-cli/commit/6eb168c)), closes [#1029](https://github.com/commitizen/cz-cli/issues/1029)
* ci(release): bump actions/checkout and actions/setup-node to v4 (#1024) ([f5702c4](https://github.com/commitizen/cz-cli/commit/f5702c4)), closes [#1024](https://github.com/commitizen/cz-cli/issues/1024)
* ci(release): use npm trusted publishing via OIDC (#1028) ([096ed52](https://github.com/commitizen/cz-cli/commit/096ed52)), closes [#1028](https://github.com/commitizen/cz-cli/issues/1028)
* chore(deps) Update all non-major dependencies (#1026) ([4e98218](https://github.com/commitizen/cz-cli/commit/4e98218)), closes [#1026](https://github.com/commitizen/cz-cli/issues/1026)
* chore(deps) Update dependency lodash to v4.18.1 [SECURITY] (#1010) ([11be6a1](https://github.com/commitizen/cz-cli/commit/11be6a1)), closes [#1010](https://github.com/commitizen/cz-cli/issues/1010)
* fix(ci): fix pipelines and update matrices to node 18/20/22 (#1023) ([48e4b8b](https://github.com/commitizen/cz-cli/commit/48e4b8b)), closes [#1023](https://github.com/commitizen/cz-cli/issues/1023)
* docs: update README.md to add contributors (#985) ([3c08866](https://github.com/commitizen/cz-cli/commit/3c08866)), closes [#985](https://github.com/commitizen/cz-cli/issues/985)
